test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The area of a triangular field whose sides are 96 m, 110 m and 146 m is equal to the area of a rectangular park whose sides are in the ratio 10 ∶ 11. The length of the longer side of the park is:
solution:
**Given:**

Sides of the triangle = 96m, 110m and 146m = The area of a rectangular park whose sides are in the ratio 10 ∶ 11

**Formula used:**

Area of the triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b)(s – c)

Where, s = (a + b + c)/2

Area of the rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

According to the question

s = (a + b + c)/2

⇒ s = (96 + 110 + 146)/2

⇒ s = 352/2

⇒ s = 176

Now,

Area of the triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b)(s – c)

⇒ √176(176 – 96)(176 – 110)(176 – 146)

⇒ √176(80 × 66 × 30)

⇒ √(11 × 16 × 5 × 16 × 11 × 6 × 6 × 5)

⇒ (11 × 16 × 5 × 6)

⇒ 5280 m²

Area of the park = length × breadth

⇒ 5280 = (10x × 11x)

⇒ 5280 = 110x²

⇒ x² = 5280/110

⇒ x² = 48

⇒ x = 4√3 m

Now,

The longer side = 11x = (11 × 4√3) = 44√3 m

**∴ The required longer side is 44√3 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**All three sides of the triangle whose length is 96 m, 110 m and 146 m, make a right-angled triangle whose base = 96 m and height = 110 m 

Area of the triangle = 1/2 × 96 × 110 = 5280 m²

Area of the park = length × breadth

⇒ 5280 = (10x × 11x)

⇒ 5280 = 110x2

⇒ x2 = 5280/110

⇒ x2 = 48

⇒ x = 4√3 m

Now,

The longer side = 11x = (11 × 4√3) = 44√3 m

∴ The required longer side is 44√3 m
